newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: Zimbabwe revises 1996 gold output to 24.7 tonnes.
newsitem.headline: Zimbabwe revises 1996 gold output to 24.7 tonnes.

text.p: Zimbabwe revised its 1996 gold production to 24.7 tonnes, the Chamber of Mines said.
Derek Bain, chief executive of the chamber which represents the industry, told Reuters the figure had been revised up from 23.7 tonnes and was a slight improvement on 1995's 24.3 tonnes.
"It has been revised to 24.7 tonnes," he said late on Monday.

Bain added that 1997 could see Zimbabwe gold output rise slightly but said plans for further expansion hinged on the bullion price, whose current weakness was casting a shadow over the local industry.
